'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Scott Lingrell LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
